exercises.instruction: Count unique words in 'essay.txt' and sort by frequency
exercises.instruction_id: Hitung kata unik di 'essay.txt' dan urutkan frekuensi
exercises.shadow_text: cat essay.txt | tr ' ' '\n' | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr
exercises.hint: tr replaces characters, uniq -c counts duplicates, sort -nr sorts numerically reverse
exercises.hint_id: tr ganti karakter, uniq -c hitung duplikat, sort -nr urut numerik terbalik
